def etcdstart.watchEnvL [srv_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (m0 :
    etcdstart.WMem GF) (ms : List (etcdstart.WMem GF)) (γr : ReadNames) (pfx : GoString) :
    client.WEnv GF :=
  { R := (ms.getD 0 m0).snd.fst, addr := (ms.getD 0 m0).fst, ics := [], conn := null, wc := null, pfx := pfx, lg := null,
    WM := v3rpc.etcdModelOfHistory γr.raft γr.kv, WL := v3rpc.histWL γr.raft γr.kv,
    mem := fun i => ((ms.getD i m0).fst, (ms.getD i m0).snd.fst), nm := ms.length, kv := γr.kv,
    W := (ms.getD 0 m0).snd.snd, memW := fun i => (ms.getD i m0).snd.snd }

theorem etcdstart.isGrpcStreamsMd_of_big [srv_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] {Req Rep : StreamMsg GF} (name :
    GoString) (Up : GoString → Nat → Req.M → IProp GF) (Spec : GoString → GrpcMd → StreamSpec Rep)
    (l : List GoString) : ([∗list] a ∈ l, isGrpcStreamMd a name (Up a) (Spec a)) ⊢ isGrpcStreamsMd l
    name Up Spec
